Strategic Communications Brief — North Yardley Engineering, Ltd.

North Yardley Engineering is a UK-incorporated technology consultancy providing cloud architecture, DevOps, and platform engineering services to mid-market and enterprise clients. The firm was incorporated in 2014 and currently employs 47 consultants across offices in London, Manchester, and (newly opened) Dublin.

The firm operates exclusively in the B2B segment. Engagements typically run 4–12 months and are structured as either fixed-scope advisory or staff-augmentation embeds. Average engagement value is £180,000.

Target client profile:
The firm serves UK and Irish technology companies between Series B and post-IPO scale (approximately 100–1,500 engineering headcount). Decision-makers reached at the engagement-formation stage are CTOs, VP Engineering, and Heads of Platform. The firm does not pursue government, defence, or financial services regulated work as a deliberate market positioning choice.

Practice areas:
1. Cloud migration (AWS, GCP, Azure — provider-agnostic by policy)
2. Platform engineering and internal developer platform design
3. Observability program design (SLO/SLA frameworks, error budgets, alerting hygiene)
4. DevOps and CI/CD modernisation
5. Cost optimisation and FinOps program design
6. Capability uplift via embedded mentorship

Differentiators (per the founding partners):
- Operating-model-first methodology, not tools-first
- Written handover documentation as a contractual deliverable on every engagement
- All consultants are former practitioners with at least 7 years of in-house experience prior to consulting
- The firm publishes a quarterly research letter ("Yardley Quarterly") covering one operational topic in depth
- Member of the British Computer Society; founding partners are Chartered IT Professionals

Voice and tone:
The brand is positioned as the "quiet expert" — restrained, evidence-led, never claiming what cannot be backed by case study. Voice should avoid superlatives, avoid first-person plural enthusiasm, and never use exclamation marks. The firm has been described by a former client as "Stripe Press, but for consulting."

Price positioning: Premium. The firm explicitly does not compete on price.

Geographic markets: United Kingdom (primary), Republic of Ireland (secondary). No active expansion outside these jurisdictions.

Contact for inbound: hello@northyardley.co.uk
